oracleReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT DISTINCT TO_CHAR(DATAVENDA, ''YYYYMM'') AS ANOMES_VENDA FROM ', pipeline().parameters.SchemaName, '.OKJ_FATOPEDIDOVENDA_PBI WHERE DATAVENDA >= TO_DATE(''', pipeline().parameters.StartAnomes, ''', ''YYYYMM'') AND DATAVENDA < TO_DATE(''', pipeline().parameters.EndAnomesExclusive, ''', ''YYYYMM'') ORDER BY 1')
